content: शाक्त {%a.%} (-क्ती|{%f.%}) [शक्तिर्देवताऽस्य अण्] .²1 Relating to power. .²2 Relating to {%Śakti%} or the female personification of divine energy. .{@-क्तः@} A worshipper of {%Śakti%}; (the {%Śāktas%} are generally worshippers of Durgā representing the female personification of divine energy, and the ritual enjoined to them is of two kinds, the pure or right hand ritual दक्षिणाचार, and impure or left-hand ritual वामाचार <ab>qq. vv.</ab>).
